ShortDescription.Value: Brings construction sites to life with progressively rising buildings, textured shadow-casting scaffolding, persistent tower cranes and animated site cleanup.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Construction Animation
Construction Animation makes building sites feel alive again in Cities: Skylines II.
Buildings rise progressively as construction advances, using their native models and textures. Procedural scaffolding follows the building footprint and height, tower cranes appear on suitable projects, and construction lots receive a temporary dirt treatment instead of the vanilla sand surface.
## Features - Progressive building construction - Native building textures and windows - Animated scaffolding that grows with the building - Scaffolding shadows and gradual dismantling after completion - Tower cranes placed near the edge of the construction lot - Temporary construction ground effects - Support for multiple simultaneous construction sites - Automatic cleanup when construction finishes
## Performance Several optimizations are included to reduce the impact of large construction sites and multiple simultaneous projects.
## Compatibility - Designed for Cities: Skylines II 1.6.x - No additional dependencies required
## Beta This mod is still in beta. Some unusual building footprints may produce visual imperfections.
⚠️ Construction Animation creates temporary procedural geometry during construction. Very large numbers of simultaneous building sites may still affect performance.
## Credits Created by Ti4goc. Developed in part with the assistance of AI tools.
Publish.ChangeLog: Major construction and performance update: - Removes the vanilla Sand Surface safely during active construction - Adds a temporary dirt brush across the construction lot - Adds a low concrete foundation following the building footprint - Restores native façade textures and window rendering on the animated building - Makes construction façades double-sided to avoid hollow-looking exterior walls - Adds textured scaffolding with cast and received shadows - Keeps scaffolding in place until the building is fully completed - Adds a 1.5-second completion hold followed by a 1.5-second fade-out before dismantling starts - Dismantles scaffolding progressively only after the completed building is visible - Keeps suitable tower cranes available during construction and excludes small residential buildings and row houses - Repositions cranes near lot corners - Generates scaffold geometry directly instead of creating thousands of temporary primitive objects - Reduces building cut-mesh rebuild frequency with an adaptive update step - Optimizes scaffold animation updates to avoid processing every floor every frame - Extends full scaffold shadow distance to 650 m
